page.overview:
Who is DIO?

After becoming a Vampire and later a Stand user, DIO has gathered around him many minions and is responsible for many major events of the series, from the death of Jonathan Joestar to the Joestar Family's sudden acquisition of Stand power, and his legacy persists throughout the series. He is the wielder of the immensely powerful The World.

DIO is the father of Giorno Giovanna, the main protagonist of Part 5, as well as a handful of other illegitimate offspring.

Dio is an exquisitely beautiful man, with long golden hair and a sexy body. Araki designed him as a "beautiful, ethereal boy" (美しい かっこいい少年) and stated that he based his visual design on the appearance of foreign idols such as singers, actors, and supermodels known for their beauty and exquisite facial features. He was also inspired by the classic tradition of beautiful shōnen manga villains. Araki specifically designed him to embody the bishounen (beautiful boy) archetype. His hair blond and his eyes green. Like traditional villains, his eyes are slightly slanted upward, and when he smiles, dimples and fangs appear. He's popular with girls, but rather than loving someone himself, he has a more controlling nature. Araki said he wanted to depict Dio as someone who always surpasses Jonathan in everything. Dio is described as gorgeous and beautiful by other characters such as Straizo, N'Doul, Mariah, and Pucci. Mohammed Avdol described him as "exuding a bewitching sensuality; it was hard to believe he was a man".

In the free booklet for Part of the anime HMV, he is described as "a beautiful young man, Dio Brando," while in the pamphlet for the Phantom Blood movie and JoJo6251, he is described as "beautiful in appearance." As such, he is the only character in JoJo who is repeatedly described in the story and official sources as "extremely beautiful" and "ethereal."

Also known as: Dio Brando.
